list: Official 55-trophy list, names, descriptions and grades as published on PlayStation, cross-checked live 2026-11-19 against Exophase and PSNProfiles (the two agree on every name, description and grade). Hidden flags follow GTA Zone's hidden/visible split (28 hidden, 27 visible). PSN progress targets come from PSNProfiles.

trophies.guide: The platinum pops the moment the other 54 trophies are yours. Nothing here needs a separate step: work through the roadmap in this guide — story first, then the 100% checklist, then Strangers & Freaks and cleanup — and this is the last trophy you earn. PowerPyx rates the whole set 4/10 and about 200 hours, all offline and single-player, so there is no online or DLC trophy standing between you and it.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy, impossible to miss. It unlocks when you finish Gone Fishing, the first main mission of Chapter 1. Just play the opening mission through and it pops at the end.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy. PowerPyx notes it unlocks when you complete the first main mission of Chapter 2, What's in the Bag?, which closes out Chapter 1. Keep playing the story and it comes on its own. While you are still in Chapter 1, do not skip the one thing that might matter later: the optional morning meditation at Jason's house (see Positive Mental Attitude).
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy. PowerPyx notes it unlocks when you complete the first main mission of Chapter 3, Welcome to Vice City, which closes out Chapter 2. Chapter 2 is also where the dual-character play opens up after the mission Coffee Break, which is what unlocks the partner trophies and the later character questlines.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy. PowerPyx notes it unlocks after the first two main missions of Chapter 4, Ocean Beach and Another Life, which close out Chapter 3. Chapter 3 is a good time to take the optional missions as they appear — several character questlines (Andy, Randy, Tyrone) open during this chapter — but none of them is missable; they all stay open after the story.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy. PowerPyx lists the final main mission, Starting From Zero, as the mission that closes Chapter 4. Finish the story's missions in order and this pops with the chapter's end; the final-mission trophy lands at the same point.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma

trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy, one of only two golds. PowerPyx names Starting From Zero as the final main mission; completing it ends the story and pops this trophy. After the credits you keep free-roam of Leonida with no mission replay, so everything left for the platinum is done in that free-roam.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy. PowerPyx places Breakfast Run as a Chapter 2 main mission. Play the story and it unlocks during that mission; it cannot be missed.
trophies.name: Trust

trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy. PowerPyx places The Cartel Heist as a Chapter 3 main mission. Finish the mission as part of the story and the trophy pops; there is nothing extra to do and nothing to miss.
trophies.name: Break the Bank

trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy. PowerPyx places Child's Play as a Chapter 4 main mission. Complete it in the story and the trophy follows; it cannot be missed.
trophies.name: Family Matters

trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy. PowerPyx places Headliners as a Chapter 4 main mission. Play through it in the story and the trophy unlocks; it cannot be missed.
trophies.name: DWNFALL

trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy. PowerPyx places VCIA Takedown as a Chapter 4 main mission. Complete the mission in the story and it pops; it cannot be missed.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked

trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy. PowerPyx places Operation Savage Glory as a Chapter 5 main mission. Finish it as part of the story and the trophy unlocks; it cannot be missed.
trophies.name: Snow Storm

trophies.guide: The hardest trophy and the second gold, but far more forgiving than it sounds. The 100% checklist appears under Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion, only after the story — yet anything you did during the story already counts toward it. PowerPyx puts it at roughly 60% true completion: most side quests are not required, collectibles are only partly required, and you need any 70 of the 80 challenges. The parts that do need everything are robberies, underwater discoveries, shooting ranges, drone races and Bret's quests. Roughly: 100 optional missions, 200 of 277 vehicles scanned, 100 of 255 animals studied, 300 stunts, 15 of 18 meditations, all 8 bank vaults and all 39 gang operations. Nothing on the checklist is missable, so work through it in free-roam after the credits.
trophies.name: A Long Road

trophies.guide: Any 250 of the 397 stunts count, mixed across the four kinds PowerPyx lists: 130 stunt jumps over ramps, 202 under-the-bridge flights, 40 knife flights between buildings and 25 base jumps. Under-the-bridge flights are the quickest to grind. Track progress per region under Progress, then Activities, then Stunts, and on the map under Exploration, then Stunt Spots, where each stunt keeps its own name and stays marked once done. For the 100% checklist you need 300 stunts, so keep going past this trophy.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Do each of the 9 activity types at least once. PowerPyx lists them as fishing, hunting, golf, shooting ranges, pool, basketball (scoring hoops), playing a video game, winning a car race / race challenge / Top Fun drone race, and performing a stunt. Check what you have done under Touchpad, then Progress, then Activities — scrolling over a type shows how many you have done — and filter the map for Activities (the blue dumbbell icon) to find the ones you have not tried. Most types come up naturally in the story and while chasing other trophies, so this usually pops on its own.
trophies.name: Master of None

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Gold all 42 shooting range challenges across the 12 range locations PowerPyx lists. The ranges are also needed in full for the 100% checklist, so there is no way around them. Practise a range until you know its target pattern, then go for gold; the medals are not as hard as they sound, and raising your Focus level (by playing ranges, golf, pool, fishing and landing headshots) makes the later ones easier.
trophies.name: The Shootist

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win one drone race at each of the 14 Top Fun locations — 42 races in total across them, and the 100% checklist wants all 42 won. Learn each course's line first with a slow run, then race it for the win; the trophy only needs one win per location, so you can leave the harder races at a location until last.
trophies.name: Top Fun

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races out of the 40 unique race locations PowerPyx lists. Winning the same race twice does not count — each win has to be at a race you have not won before. Work through the map's race spots one at a time, and keep this in mind while doing Top Fun races and race challenges, since those wins can overlap with this count.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Follow Cal's fishing questline. PowerPyx says that after the Chapter 1 mission Feng Shui, where you meet Cal, he sends a text that marks a fishing spot with a purple map icon. Go to the spot and work through his fishing challenges; beating Cal in one of them pops the trophy. The questline stays available after the story.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

trophies.guide: Finish one of the four arcade games, called Video Games in-game: Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III, Time Jackers Rewind, or Bang For Your Buck. PowerPyx says the first three are playable on the TV at home by interacting with the controllers — you can start in Chapter 1 — while Bang For Your Buck is on arcade machines out in the world. To complete a game, finish all of its levels at least once; you do not need to beat every challenge inside it. Pick the one you enjoy most.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's five-quest line, which is Lucia-only. PowerPyx says it opens automatically in Chapter 3: while playing as Lucia you get a call from Andy, then a text with her home address that marks the line on the map in Belville. The five quests are Climbing the Cellerichain (parts 1-3), Pay the Cellerica Fee, Peach!, Read the Label and Puff Puff Pass. All of them stay available after the story, so there is no rush.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's treasure-diving line — 7 shipwrecks in total. PowerPyx says it opens in Chapter 1: a while after the mission Island Dreams (Work for Kenton) he calls, then marks himself with a green KR icon in Key Lento. He marks purple treasure-chest icons on the map; dive to each wreck, use the metal detector to dig the treasure from the ocean floor, and bring it back. After the first set he calls you back for more. Kenton goes away for a stretch after Chapter 1 and returns in Chapters 2-3 — playing as Jason, calling Brian speeds his return — so the line is not missable. Track it under Progress, then Characters, then Kenton Rees.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's five-quest line at the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County. PowerPyx says it opens automatically after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break. The five quests are Thrillbillies, Twist Wrist Smash Grab, Mall Rats, The Impaler and Hometown Heroes. Every quest stays available after the story, so work through them whenever you like.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 Strangers & Freaks strands — but only certain questlines count. PowerPyx confirms Kirk (the Skunk Ape strand), Kyle (McKittrick Farm), Yago (street racing) and Pilot Pete (deliveries) count, while Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy and Eddie do not count as strangers for this trophy. All of them are still findable after the story in free-roam, so take them as you find them and watch the trophy tracker count climb. The strands are not needed for the 100% checklist, so this is a separate cleanup step.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish Randy's Wish List: deliver 16 sports cars he wants. PowerPyx says the line opens after the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS, where you steal the Zorrusso for Randy and unlock the Key Cloner for breaking into high-end sports cars. Track the list under Map, then Robberies, then Randy's Wish List; he marks some cars for you, but you can also steal them off the street — scan a car with the WAiNK app to see if it is on the list, then drive it back to his garage (green RK icon in west Vice City). Delivering a car in good condition pays more. It all stays open after the story.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's lab-busting line, which is Jason-only. PowerPyx says it opens after the Chapter 3 mission Here, Kitty Kitty: purple markers appear for Synthetic Labs in Vice City, and the quest Take Out Kitty Litter has you destroy them. After enough labs are destroyed, Tyrone gives the second quest, Spin On This, which unlocks the trophy. Everything stays available after the story.
trophies.name: Spin On This!

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: THE ONE TROPHY THAT MAY BE MISSABLE — do the Chapter 1 meditation. There are 18 meditation spots across 10 locations, and meditating with both Jason and Lucia at a spot counts double. PowerPyx says the first meditation is offered only in Chapter 1 at Jason's house: in the morning after the mission Down to Earth, talk to Lucia in the kitchen — she says she is going to meditate — follow her to the balcony and choose Accept. That spot is gone for good after Chapter 1, and PowerPyx notes it is still unconfirmed whether the trophy actually needs it (it is not marked as a regular meditation spot, though it does raise the counter by one). Do it anyway to be safe. The last meditation needs both characters playable together, which opens after Chapter 2's Coffee Break. Track spots under Progress, then Collections, then Exploration, then Meditations. Note: the 100% checklist only needs 15 of 18, so this cannot cost you A Long Road.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Work through Bret Vogel's hunting line, which is Jason-only. PowerPyx says it opens at some point after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break: while playing as Jason you get a text from Bret that marks his first quest, Veteran Hunted, in Lummox County. His quests are about hunting animals he requests and bringing them to him; on the first quest he gives you the unique hunting rifle Killtelligence SM-69, retrievable from any weapon locker at Ammu-Nation. One clean shot keeps an animal in pristine condition and pays more, but that is not required. Track the hunts under Map, then Activities, then Target Deck — there are 15 Target Decks, all needed for the 100% checklist. PowerPyx notes it is still unconfirmed exactly which animal pops this trophy, so keep hunting through Bret's line and it will come.
trophies.name: Fair Game

trophies.guide: Complete any 3 of the 18 collectible card sets PowerPyx lists. Cards are found across Leonida; collect full sets of cards and this pops at the third completed set. You do not need all 18 sets, and the sets are not required for the 100% checklist, so this is a pure collectible hunt — work through set locations one set at a time and tick them off here as you go. No source checked pins down a single best route, so use any card-set map you trust and clear sets in the order that suits your playthrough.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

trophies.guide: Scan any 100 WAiNK spots. PowerPyx breaks the world down as 31 landmarks, 35 curiosities, 23 sculptures and No Flusher tags — far more than 100 in total, so it does not matter which ones you scan. Hold up on the D-pad and then R1 while looking at a scannable object to WAiNK it. You will rack up scans naturally while exploring and hunting vehicles, so just keep scanning anything the app highlights.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

trophies.guide: Complete any 50 of the 80 challenges. PowerPyx notes the 100% checklist needs 70 of 80, so this pops on the way to that. View and track them under Progress, then Challenges, where a checkmark shows each completed one. Most complete passively while you work on other trophies — stunts, races, robberies, hunting — so leave this for late, then pick the easiest remaining challenges to reach 50.
trophies.name: One Last Thing

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Do this after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, when you can free-roam with Jason and Lucia together — call your partner by holding right on the D-pad and pressing triangle. Then cause enough chaos to reach 4 stars and escape the red heat zone (not just the flashing search area). PowerPyx's tip: drive through the train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County — police struggle to follow on the tracks and the helicopter cannot see you. It also pops automatically during the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is…, since bank vault robberies always bring 4 stars, so you may get it without trying.
trophies.name: Hot Together

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Only possible after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, when both characters can be together — call your partner with hold-right plus triangle. Then hit 3 robbery targets (green map icons) in a row while staying wanted the whole time: keep the red/blue flashing wanted level and never let it drop. PowerPyx recommends the 3 jewelry stores in the north of Vice City, which open after the Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs — rob a couple of items in each store and ideally crack the back-room safe with sticky bombs. The unlock is delayed about half a minute after leaving the third shop, and if it does not pop, hit a fourth shop and keep going. Bring an armored vest, sticky bombs and healing items from Ammu-Nation.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

trophies.guide: Scan 100 different vehicles with the WAiNK app — hold up on the D-pad to open it instantly, then look at a vehicle and hold R1 to scan. You do not need to drive them; scanning is enough. PowerPyx counts 557 vehicles at launch, so stand on a busy road and scan everything passing by. Check totals under Touchpad, then Progress, then Vehicles. You need 200 of the 277 base models scanned for the 100% checklist, so this pops on the way there.
trophies.name: Whip It Good

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Activate Combat Focus with L3 + R3 while aiming a firearm: time slows and weak spots are highlighted, draining the purple focus bar. You must drop 5 enemies inside one activation, so set it up first. PowerPyx's advice: buff your focus beforehand with food, drinks, or a wash at home, and use Adrenaline to stretch the slow-time window; line up 5 enemies at a gang operation, wear body armor from Ammu-Nation, and use an accurate full-auto rifle such as the Duke 556. PowerPyx also notes the trophy does not seem to work on soldiers, police or civilians — use gang enemies. Focus has 4 levels (check Touchpad, then Jason & Lucia, then Focus); raise it by playing shooting ranges, golf, pool, fishing and landing headshots, and by the time you reach level 4 this comes much easier, often naturally.
trophies.name: Gunslinger

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Steal a large passenger plane docked at a departure terminal at Vice City International Airport — it has to be one connected to a passenger boarding bridge, not one parked on the airfield. PowerPyx's easiest pick is the plane at departure terminals E3/E4: drive through a fence around the airfield, head to the plane, go up the stairs by the boarding bridge, enter through the door, go upstairs to the cockpit, reverse the plane to the airstrip and take off. Fly at least 1 km (0.6 miles) away from the airport and the trophy pops — the unlock is slightly delayed, so keep flying until it lands.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can

trophies.guide: Steal a military tank. PowerPyx places them at Mile Zero Air Station, the island on the south-west edge of the map in Mariana County — the tanks stand in the south of the base. Drive through the gate (or take the stunt jump by the south-east entrance), climb into a tank and shoot enemies until the trophy pops. Expect a 3-star wanted level on the way out.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: First finish the Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs: it unlocks the Snap Gun for silently lockpicking alarmed doors, and jewelry store robberies appear as green icons on the map in unfogged areas. Approach a store's back door and use the Snap Gun instead of kicking it in — kicking trips the alarm. Inside, find the note with the safe code in the back room and loot the safe. PowerPyx names Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City as a good spot. The Snap Gun stays in your inventory permanently, so you can retry at any store.
trophies.name: Sneakthief

trophies.guide: Rob any 5 of the 8 large bank vaults. First finish the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is… (Wait at the Cafe), which introduces the vaults: tail a security van until it stops at a bank, then a guard carries a briefcase into the bank and the vault opens — go in fast, grab the cash (bring your partner and hand off a bag), and escape. After that, pay Yasmani for security-van tips ($10,000 each; finish his earlier Payday Loans jobs first) and vans are marked with purple icons. Each vault robbery brings a 4-star wanted level, so escape on a fast motorcycle and switch cars to break recognition. The 100% checklist needs all 8, so this pops on the way. A single bank can pay up to $205,000 — the best money in the endgame.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: The easy way is the same mission that unlocks bank vaults: the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is… has you tail an armored truck to a bank, and robbing that vault counts as robbing an armored truck. Escape the red heat radius (or use a Pay 'n' Spray) and the trophy pops. You can also do it earlier: armored trucks drive around Vice City near banks — block one, plant a sticky bomb on its back door and blow it open, then escape the heat radius. Sticky bombs are in the back of Yasmani's shop after his jobs.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

trophies.guide: Unfog the whole map — all 52 areas the PSN target counts. The fastest way, per PowerPyx, is by plane: fly over every black-fogged patch until the entire map is visible. It is pure travel, so combine it with flying between other objectives and it will finish itself. No source checked names a single required route, so any plane and any order works.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal operation for each of the 9 gangs — PowerPyx counts 39 operations in total. They appear as yellow icons on the map when you go near them, and many are marked automatically from story progress. Track each gang under Progress, then Gangs, where scrolling over a gang shows how many of its operations you have robbed. The 100% checklist needs all 39, so this pops early on the way there.
trophies.name: Pest Control

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: NOT YET PINNED DOWN — no source checked has cracked this one. PowerPyx lists In The Beginning… as currently unknown, and GTA Zone lists it as unconfirmed. The description points to having a cocktail somewhere with a view on Ocean Beach, but no guide has confirmed the exact bar, drink or trigger as of 19 November 2026. Do not trust a guessed location: check PowerPyx's guide again — it is updated as players crack these — and this entry will be updated when a source confirms it.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: NOT YET PINNED DOWN — no source checked has cracked this one. PowerPyx lists Capital Offense as currently unknown, and GTA Zone lists it as unconfirmed, guessing only that the description points to driving out through a showroom window. That guess is not confirmed, so no specific showroom or method is given here. Check PowerPyx's guide again as players crack it, and this entry will be updated when a source confirms the trigger.
trophies.name: Capital Offense

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Rob the Kingpin Bowling gang operation in Port Gellhorn and steal all 3 key valuables, then escape the police — the trophy pops after the escape, not on the third pickup. PowerPyx says the spot opens during the Chapter 2 optional mission Hit Kingpin Bowling. Bring sticky bombs from Ammu-Nation for the safe. The three valuables: a luxury watch in the south-east office, the unique shotgun Gutterball Moreland 850 on a table in the north-east corner, and the safe in the north-east hallway (blow it with sticky bombs). You do not need all three in one visit: the robbery icon respawns after a long time, so you can return for whatever you missed. Killing the enemies is not required.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling

trophies.guide: Reach maximum Strength with both Jason and Lucia at the same time. This only works after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, when you can switch between the two characters. Work out at a fitness club — PowerPyx says to always go together: call your partner with hold-right plus triangle, and while one character actively trains, the other completes their training automatically, so you make double progress. Find clubs on the map under Activities (the dumbbell icon); there are plenty across Vice City, and you can also work out at home after the story. Check each character's Strength under Touchpad, then Jason & Lucia, then the heart icon.
trophies.name: Personal Best

trophies.guide: Perform 500 actions that affect your Criminal Profile. Turn on profile notifications first (Settings, then UI, then HUD Notifications, then Criminal Profile = On) so a small demon face appears on the right of the screen whenever an action counts. PowerPyx lists the profiles from cleanest to worst: Professional (stealthy objectives, destroying evidence, clean escapes), Hardened (incapacitating without killing), Violent (killing enemies and civilians), Psycho (killing large numbers of cops and civilians, driving over gravestones) and Irredeemable — which is permanent, so do not push that far. Almost every robbery and enemy encounter counts, so this usually arrives passively while you chase other trophies; if it is last, farming it is as simple as running over civilians and cops with a car, though at Psycho the police shoot on sight more often.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

trophies.guide: NOT YET PINNED DOWN — no source checked has cracked this one. PowerPyx lists Bad Luck, I Guess as currently unknown, believed to be related to the Payday Loans store from the prologue, but that is a belief, not a confirmed trigger. GTA Zone also lists it as unconfirmed. Do not trust a guessed method: check PowerPyx's guide again as players crack it, and this entry will be updated when a source confirms the exact trigger.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess

trophies.guide: NOT YET PINNED DOWN — no source checked has cracked this one. PowerPyx lists The Truth Is Out There as currently unknown, believed to be from a UFO questline, but that is a belief, not a confirmed trigger. GTA Zone also lists it as unconfirmed. Do not trust a guessed method: check PowerPyx's guide again as players crack it, and this entry will be updated when a source confirms the exact trigger.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: NOT YET PINNED DOWN — no source checked has cracked this one. PowerPyx lists Ten Pin as currently unknown, believed to be from kicking enemies while driving a motorcycle, but that is a belief, not a confirmed trigger. GTA Zone also lists it as unconfirmed. Do not trust a guessed method: check PowerPyx's guide again as players crack it, and this entry will be updated when a source confirms the exact trigger.
trophies.name: Ten Pin

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder a running total of $250,000 in marked bills — not all at once. First finish the Chapter 3 mission Credit Check (Meet Raul's Crew), which unlocks the Dye Pack Jammer for laundering. Then rob banks and Payday Loans and carry the marked bills to a fence; PowerPyx says Yasmani in Vice City pays the most. It comes naturally while doing robberies for the 100% checklist, and bank vaults alone can pay up to $205,000 in one job once they open after the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is….
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

trophies.guide: Spend a running total of $100,000 across all shop types — it does not have to be in one place or at once. The fastest way, per PowerPyx, is the expensive stuff: guns, car mods and tattoos. PowerPyx counts the shops as 14 mod shops, 19 Pay 'n' Sprays, 24 Ammu-Nations, 67 clothing stores, 17 footwear stores, 18 hair and beauty salons, 11 tattoo studios and 15 electronics stores. You will spend a lot of this naturally on gear, ammo and cars, so check your total late in the run and top it up with a few big purchases.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

trophies.guide: Buy all 8 purchasable garages — the 4 story-related garages do not count — for about $160,000 in total. They go on sale after the Chapter 2 mission Daily Driver (Steal the Crawler for Moses), when the Vice City Real Estate app is installed on your phone; buy them through that app. Money is the only barrier, and robberies pay better and better in Chapters 3-4, so save this for after the story when cash is plentiful. Garages also matter for On the Spot, since each one adds parking spots for registered vehicles.
trophies.name: Little Boxes

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 stolen vehicles in the Scooter Bros app, which lets you summon them to your location. The app arrives on your phone after the Chapter 2 mission Moses (Take A Vehicle to Moses), which also unlocks Moses himself. Drive stolen vehicles to Moses in Port Gellhorn, then in his garage choose Respray and Register. At first he only takes vehicles without trackers; from Chapter 3 you can also register cars with standard trackers at any Pay 'n' Spray. Each garage you own adds parking spots, so buy garages first (see Little Boxes) — and pick cheap low-end cars and bikes to keep the registration fees down.
trophies.name: On the Spot
